protocol: Split by target timestamp AND issue_time>=fit cutoff for evaluation; preserve overlapping issues, each issue/target pair has weight 1. Select on two pre-January expanding folds; freeze before January test. Complete SCADA hours only. Historical NWP availability conditional (+9h). Bias=mean(prediction-actual). No capacity normalization.

pretest_selection.selection: lowest unweighted mean of two fold RMSEs; ties preserve insertion-order baseline
lowest unweighted mean of two fold RMSEs; ties preserve insertion-order baseline

estimator_relationship: January metrics belong to estimators fitted only on pre-January targets. model_version identifies final production refit, not the January-test estimator. Same family/configuration, different fitted parameters.
